# U of U IM Codes and Rapid Responses

Canonical site: https://reblocke.github.io/U-of-U-IM-Codes-and-Rapid-Responses/
Source repository: https://github.com/reblocke/U-of-U-IM-Codes-and-Rapid-Responses/
Repository status: public Quarto course website and open educational resource.

## Purpose

This repository hosts learner-facing and facilitator-facing materials for a University
of Utah Internal Medicine seminar on Code Blue and Rapid Response leadership. The course
teaches residents to make leadership explicit, prepare pulse checks, identify shockable
rhythms, use bedside and outreach expertise, escalate resources, close events, hand off,
and debrief.

## Current Site Structure

- `index.qmd` / `docs/index.html`: learner hub.
- `modules.qmd` / `docs/modules.html`: module index.
- `slides/leadership.qmd`: leadership state, foot-of-bed position, thinking out loud,
  and flattening hierarchy.
- `slides/pulse_check.qmd`: shock/no-shock decisions, compression pauses, fine VF,
  airway timing, EtCO2, and ROSC.
- `slides/nurse_response.qmd`: bedside nurse and outreach collaboration, trajectory,
  disposition, and missing resources.
- `slides/escalation_closure.qmd`: CPR duration huddles, family presence, stopping
  ACLS, family update, and debrief.
- `scenarios.qmd` and `slides/case_*.qmd`: practice scenarios.
- `resources.qmd`: learner resources and quick reference links.
- `facilitators.qmd`: instructor notes and setup links.
- `docs/`: rendered GitHub Pages output.

## Scholarly Outputs

This is not a journal-paper repository. Related course-evaluation outputs are ATS
abstracts/posters:

- 2025 ATS abstract: Ryden AG, Krauspe E, Patel S, Wayne R, Davis M, Locke BW.
  "Enhancing Intern Leadership of Inpatient Emergencies: Evaluating the Impact of a
  Seminar Addressing Team Dynamics." AJRCCM. 2025;211(Supplement_1):A5624.
  DOI: https://doi.org/10.1164/ajrccm.2025.211.abstracts.a5624
- 2026 ATS abstract: Situmeang J, Ryden A, Long CW, Krauspe E, Patel S, Sheth R,
  Locke BW. "B38-12 Intern Code Blue and Rapid Response Leadership: A Pre-post
  Evaluation of a Micro-Module Curriculum." AJRCCM. 2026;212(Supplement_1):aamag162.939.
  DOI: https://doi.org/10.1093/ajrccm/aamag162.939
  Oxford page: https://academic.oup.com/ajrccm/article/212/Supplement_1/aamag162.939/8680845

## Data Boundaries

The teaching site and authored course materials are public. Course-evaluation source
data are restricted because they can include trainee-linking identifiers, timestamps,
free-text responses, REDCap metadata, and small-cell educational evaluation records.
Do not commit raw REDCap exports, survey PDFs, local workbooks, R exports, generated
analysis HTML/PDF folders, or participant-level outputs. Use `data_dictionary.md` and
`data_dictionary.csv` for schema-level documentation.

## Build And Verification

Prerequisite: Quarto.

```bash
quarto check
quarto render
quarto preview
```

After rendering, confirm `docs/llms.txt`, `docs/search.json`, and `docs/sitemap.xml`
exist and browser-check the rendered site.

## Agent Cautions

- Do not overstate the ATS abstracts as full journal papers.
- Do not mirror full ATS abstract text or publisher PDFs.
- Preserve the stable teaching payload unless the user asks for course-content edits.
- Do not add PHI, trainee identifiers, raw survey exports, or local analysis data.
- Edit source `.qmd` files before rendering `docs/`; do not hand-edit generated HTML.
